description: An acute toxin-mediated superficial skin disorder caused by Staphylococcus aureus.

appearance.general: Tender erythema, superficial blistering, and widespread superficial peeling can occur.

warning_signs: Widespread blistering or superficial skin peeling, especially with systemic illness, requires urgent medical evaluation.
